note.question: How can customer relationships be detected from transactional data and used to target promotions to the right customers?
note.overview: Retailers have become increasingly interested in personalizing their products and services such as promotions. For this, we need new personalized demand models. Unfortunately, social data are not available to many retailers because of cost and privacy issues.
